invalidAlias.description: Whether we have an invalid alias name

aliasHintText.description: If we have an invalid alias name, what is the hint text to show

invalidDescription.description: Whether we have an invalid description

descriptionHintText.description: If we have an invalid description, what is the hint text to show

selected.description: Whether a field type is selected. a local field type is selected by default, and a remote field type is unselected by default

alwaysDisable.description: Whether this field should always be disabled. (e.g the column with id alias name)

invalidTimeFormat.description:
Indicates whether the time format is invalid.
This field is set to true if the provided time format does not match any of the valid formats.

timeFormat.description:
The format of the time.
This field stores the time format string, such as 'HH:mm:ss', e.t.c.

timeFormatHintText.description:
Hint text for the time format.
This field provides a hint or error message related to the time format, displayed to the user.

mismatch.description: Whether we have a schema mismatch on this field type

title: Holds the UI related settings for the {@link DeclaredFieldType}
name: DataFusionUiDeclaredFieldTypeUiSettings
